profile.headline: Senior Unity / C# Developer | 3D Simulation & Training| Shipped PC, Mobile & VR Applications | C++ Qt | Full stack development | U.S. Navy Veteran
profile.summary:
Extraordinary, problem solving developer, looking for an extraordinary team to work and excel with. My diversity in many engines and languages makes me a great addition to any team, but I accel at game development, especially when it involves creativity, and hard to solve problems, that other developers are afraid to approach. I enjoy tackling complicated problems head-on.

My strongest work is in Unity and C#: 3D training applications, gameplay systems, developer tools, and reusable frameworks. At Carley Corporation, I progressed from Software Engineer to Senior Software Engineer while developing four realistic military training applications. I translated technical procedures and equipment behavior into interactive software using Unity, C#, JSON, and XML

Alongside my professional roles, I have developed games independently since 2010 and shipped work across Android, PC, and Xbox. I built Creature Crafter GO, a GPS-based multiplayer game with 12 mini-games, Firestore integration, and leaderboards. My experience also includes VR interactions, height-based A* navigation, custom shaders, UI, AI, and multiplayer systems using Unity Relay and Netcode.

My background extends beyond games. As a Software Engineer at Pfizer, I developed full-stack and backend software for large biological-sequence datasets, including proteins and antigens. I used Groovy/Grails and Java, modeled persistence with GORM/Hibernate, manually modified relational tables and schemas, and supported the application on company-hosted Linux servers. Separately, as a Software Developer at Infosys, I built an AWS-hosted social-media application using Amazon RDS, S3, EC2, Dockerized microservices, Angular, and TypeScript. At ISPA Technology, I developed C++/Qt software for military mine-sweeping.

I enjoy owning a feature from the initial technical problem through implementation, debugging, optimization, and release. As a U.S. Navy veteran and former nuclear reactor operator and engineering laboratory technician, I also bring experience working with complex technical systems and procedures.
I am seeking remote software engineering opportunities, including Unity/C# simulation and tools, game development, and backend or full-stack applications. I am based in North Carolina and authorized to work in the U.S. My portfolio includes released games and demonstrations of the systems behind them.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
owned the end-to-end software development lifecycle, taking responsibility for projects from requirements definition through development, testing, deployment, and ongoing delivery. I collaborated directly with stakeholders to translate business and technical needs into practical software solutions, designed and implemented new features, managed source control and Jira-based development workflows, and maintained CI/CD processes. I also developed testing and quality-assurance practices to ensure reliable releases. A key part of my role involved solving complex performance and optimization challenges, including finding creative ways to deliver high-end software capabilities on lower-specification hardware. This combination of technical ownership, stakeholder collaboration, and hands-on engineering allowed me to drive projects from initial requirements through production.

- Developed four realistic 3D military training applications using Unity, C#, JSON, JS, HTML, and XML, turning technical procedures and equipment behavior into interactive software.
- Progressed from Software Engineer to Senior Software Engineer.
- Built and maintained modular, data-driven features, dependencies, implementation approaches, and project risks.
- Diagnosed production issues and improved application reliability, maintainability, usability, and performance.
- Maintained a secure environment while dealing with Sensitive material (CUI, Confidential), and maintained a secret clearance.
- Fully architected software to run in Unity that allowed quick and easy creation of Graded Procedures. It allowed easy tie-in to in game interactions with grading and feedback.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Unity · Software Infrastructure · Software Design · Software Systems Engineering · Simulation Software

- Designed, built, shipped, and supported games and applications across Android, PC, and Xbox, and Web GL, owning architecture, implementation, debugging, deployment, and maintenance.
- Developed reusable Unity tools and gameplay infrastructure covering shaders, navigation, UI, AI, networking, and data integrations.

Releases:
- Creature Crafter GO, 3D GPS-based multiplayer game with 12 mini-games, Firestore, and leaderboards.
- Gamblue Up - Android, Unity Relay/Netcode
- Cult - Firebase/NoSQL turn-based multiplayer.
- Orbital Rise - Procedurally generated levels. Endless mode. Leaderboards, IAP, Ads, Achievements, Google Play
- Gurps CS -  app made for character creation for Generic Universal RolePlay. Paypal,
- Tower Hero -  3D Tower Defense game. 22 AI characters and 11 bosses. 15 Spells. Dynamic destruction. Juice
- Many Game jams done in 48 hrs on Twitch.io.
positions.insights: Skills: Skilled Multi-tasker · Self-Management · Product Development · Game Design · 3D Modeling
